title: Migrate tests/coap/test_lci_identity_vectors.py embedded native-profile address corpus to upstream AddrForKey
description: Discovered while verifying no4g (flaky edhoc test fix; unrelated to that fix — pre-existing failure, verified present with fix stashed). tests/coap/test_lci_identity_vectors.py::test_full_identity_addresses_match_key_derivation asserts VECTORS['get_full_identity']['input']['addrs']['primary'] == str(native_address_from_pubkey(pubkey)) and fails: vector pins native-profile '206:2f7c:...' but native_address_from_pubkey now derives '2ed:4242:...' post-i72x migration. Same stale-corpus class as root_dio_signature.json (i72x.6), address_collision.json (rqiq), tunnel_authorization.json (osjz): regenerate the lci identity vectors with upstream AddrForKey-derived addresses (oracle: pinned yggdrasil_address.json anchors, not implementation output), then flip the test. Do NOT weaken the assertion.
